author: Komorebi P.

entries.title: Exact arithmetic packet reconstruction
entries.scope: Coefficient selectors over finite residue classes, idempotence, orthogonality, exact reconstruction and divisor refinement. Formal power-series versions use actual coefficients. Labels range over standard residues; modulus is positive for reconstruction. No new analytic convergence assertion.

entries.title: Unit EGF coordinate change
entries.scope: Actual exponential-series encode/decode over a characteristic-zero field. The inverse power series is constructed from constant coefficient one. Binomial convolution, inverse identities and conjugated packet laws are proved. The statement is formal/coefficientwise, not a separate analytic convergence theorem.

entries.title: Filtered triangular reconstruction
entries.scope: Finite coefficient-row divisibility over an arbitrary commutative ring, specialized to actual p-adic integers. Weights are natural numbers or infinity, with infinity denoting a zero coefficient. This proves the omitted-tail assertion. Weight growth is not needed for an individual finite row; no infinite-limit convergence theorem is claimed.

entries.title: Triangular congruential inverse
entries.scope: Rational coefficients constructed by well-founded forward substitution, nonzero binomial diagonal proved, unique solution proved. The reciprocal-series identity and actual original exponential-section product are proved using power-series expansion. For the original source formula, N>0 and 0<=j<N are explicit.

entries.title: Universal denominator clearing
entries.scope: The product of the binomial diagonal entries clears every constructed rational coefficient. The proof derives denominator divisibility through a general integer triangular system; it does not assume integral packet coefficients.

entries.title: Odd-power generating function
entries.scope: Actual rational formal exponential series and the literal integer alternating odd-power sum. Proves the full generating-function identity and its even-part identity for every odd positive length, including composite lengths and length one. Formal/coefficientwise scope, not a separate analytic convergence theorem.

entries.title: Odd-prime Euler reconstruction
entries.scope: Constructs integral signed Euler coefficients from the same C_(2,0) triangular recurrence and proves their sech generating function. Inverse coefficients are an integer binomial convolution, with their signed odd-zigzag identity proved through actual formal sine/cosine and derivative of tan. Proves exact reconstruction in every even row for any odd length and the unit triangular row properties. No Euler reconstruction or zigzag coefficient expansion is assumed.

entries.title: Uniform odd-prime supercongruence ladder
entries.scope: Actual integer divisibility by p^(2M+2), derived from the proved reconstruction and integral inverse coefficients, with min(M,n/2) truncation. All even rows, all depths, and odd-prime specialization included. In fact valid for every odd positive integer length. Complete retention is exact. Example 4.4 is separately kernel-checked and proves the guaranteed modulus is attained; it does not imply a stronger uniform modulus.

entries.title: Dyadic integrality of the inverse coefficients
entries.scope: Actual rational ordinary coefficients of the unit reciprocal kernel. Legendre factorial valuation bound proves integral kernel coefficients; strong induction proves the actual reciprocal has integral coefficients. The cleared formal-series identity B(z)sinh(z)^2=z^2 connects beta to the manuscript germ without inverting a zero-constant series. Actual Z_2 coefficient witnesses are constructed. The unnumbered Bernoulli closed formula is not independently formalized.

entries.title: Dyadic integrality of the source
entries.scope: The actual rational source R_(2n)=(3^(2n+2)-1)/(4(2n+1)(2n+2)). The pinned LTE theorem proves equal numerator and denominator 2-adic valuations. Source nonzeroness and valuation exactly zero are established; the coefficient embeds as a genuine unit of Z_2, for all n including zero.

entries.title: Exact weighted dyadic Euler coordinate theorem
entries.scope: The independently defined dyadic source and actual reciprocal beta series multiply after rescaling by two to the previously identified Euler sech series. Exact coefficient extraction derives the complete finite rational row with actual descending factorials. Both degree 2n and arbitrary even-degree statements are checked. Rational equalities are transported to Z_2 using proved integrality, not assumed valuations. Formal series only; no additional analytic convergence claim.

entries.title: Weighted dyadic supercongruence
entries.scope: The actual min(M,n)-truncation has error divisible by 2^(2M+2) in Z_2 for every row and depth. A separate theorem proves that the rational normalized error belongs to the 2-adically integral subring of Q. Zero row and complete retention are included. This is not divisibility in the field Q_2 and does not use the finite valuation default at zero.
